## Spec

`docs/tickets/120_R2.14__telemetry-exporter-seam.md` — discharge the
telemetry residual: DF-S1.14-1's Stage-2 emitter classes (M5/M6/M13–M15
from real producing paths), the `turn_phase_profile` view and the MCP/ACP
propagation carriers; DF-S1.14-2's convention-shaped sink fixtures with
lift-back, hosted `n/a` sweep and per-configuration catalogue
distributions; DF-S1.14-4's live exporter seam — the subscriber runtime
tailing `read(run)`, egress-mediated sink delivery, durable
`measurement.export.*` lifecycle rows, hosted `participant_reported` and
the `delivered`/`activated`/`followed` §05c/§05f classes.

## Requirements

1. The residual emitter classes of DF-S1.14-1 minted from real producing
   paths (not scaffolding) + `turn_phase_profile` + propagation carriers
   where the surfaces exist.
2. DF-S1.14-2 residual: convention-shaped sink fixtures with lift-back,
   the hosted `n/a` sweep, per-configuration catalogue distributions.
3. DF-S1.14-4: a subscriber runtime tailing `read(run)` driving
   `measurement.export.*` rows; egress-mediated sink delivery through
   R2.9's mediator; `participant_reported` verified landed; the
   `delivered`/`activated`/`followed` classes verified landed.
4. DF-S1.14-1/-2/-4 discharged or reduced to dated residuals.

## Plan / implementation

- `crates/hh-telemetry/src/phase.rs` (new) — `turn_phase_profile(run,
  turn_id, events, clock_tolerance_ms)`: the M2 phase partition as a
  pure fold; innermost-owns claim order (permission → sampling → tool →
  compaction); `unbounded_intervals`; `clock_skew_flag`; typed
  `n/a{observability}` when boundary stamps are absent.
- `crates/hh-telemetry/src/propagation.rs` — `meta_carrier` /
  `acp_hh_members` / `inbound_carrier` / `carrier_loss` added to the
  landed W3C seam: the `hh` tracestate member (`run:<id>;ev:<id>`) +
  `hh.configuration_id` baggage; strict parse — malformed/absent
  members refuse `InvalidInboundContext` or name the dropped member,
  never a silent graft.
- `crates/hh-telemetry/src/openinfer.rs` (new) — the OpenInference
  convention lowering (`openinference.span.kind=LLM`,
  `llm.token_count.*`), named `LossEntry` per unrepresentable member,
  `lower_run_refs` stamping liftable coordinates.
- `crates/hh-telemetry/src/lift.rs` (new) — `lift_span` →
  `Option<EventRef>` over the `hh.run_id`/`hh.event_id` namespaced
  extension attributes; foreign spans lift `None`.
- `crates/hh-telemetry/src/genai.rs` — `lower_run_refs` liftable half
  (the same carrier stamps).
- `crates/hh-telemetry/src/views.rs` — `metric_view_scoped` (the
  `applies_to` participant-class gate → `n/a{class}`; `metric_view`
  delegates native-scoped, byte-identical); per-`configuration_id`
  catalogue distributions (`n`/`min`/`p50`/`p95`/`max`);
  `measured_value` (bare-int + `{value,measured_at}` spellings);
  `DurationSource::TimingMember` (in `scope.rs`); `EnvironmentOp` →
  `env_handle`, `Wakeup` → `subscription_id` scope-coordinate fixes.
- `crates/hh-mcp/src/client.rs` — `call_tool_carried` /
  `call_tool_propagated`; `crates/hh-mcp/src/executor.rs` —
  `McpExecutor::set_propagation` (the seam carries the context through
  tool execution).
- `crates/hh-acp/src/artifact.rs` — `to_notification_propagated`; the
  shared `notification` builder joins `acp_hh_members` into `_meta.hh`
  beside `source_seq` (existing members preserved; `to_notification`
  byte-identical).
- `crates/hh-embed/src/subscriber.rs` (new) — `ExportSubscriber::poll`:
  `read(watermark+1)` durable tail → `export_events` under the declared
  `SinkPolicy` (consent/rate/content gates pre-wire) → one `net_egress`
  POST through the caller's `EgressMediator` →
  `measurement.export.delivered` via `commit_kernel_row_for` only on
  `Forwarded`; refused/asked/credential-refused append nothing.
- Emitter stamps on the producing paths: `hh-control/src/driver.rs`
  (turn boundary `started_at_ms`/`turn_e2e_ms`, `wall_ms`, compaction
  `duration_ms{value,measured_at}` + `at_ms`, effect `at_ms`),
  `hh-env/src/driver.rs` + `events.rs` (`env_ms`/`snapshot_ms` measured
  members, op `at_ms`), `hh-ledger/src/{classes,store,views,wakeup}.rs`
  (`sleep_ms`, `EFFECT_FIELDS` `at_ms`, scope-coordinate table entries,
  `ViewKind::TurnPhaseProfile`).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0346` — owned decisions (member-stamped durations;
  the `hh` carrier; lift-back coordinates; the subscriber-as-egress-
  participant; innermost-owns partition; scoped `n/a` fold).

## Test matrix

| AC | test |
|----|------|
| carrier loss spells dropped members | `carrier_loss_spells_dropped_members` |
| MCP `_meta` carrier round-trips inbound | `mcp_meta_carrier_round_trips_through_inbound_carrier` |
| malformed/absent inbound carrier refused | `inbound_carrier_refuses_malformed_and_absent_members` |
| ACP `_meta.hh` flat members + preserved metadata | `acp_hh_members_carry_the_flat_spelling` |
| GenAI liftable leg stamps the carrier | `genai_liftable_leg_stamps_the_same_carrier` |
| OpenInference lowering + loss + lift-back | `openinference_lowering_names_loss_and_lifts_back` |
| per-configuration catalogue distributions | `catalogue_distributions_fold_per_configuration` |
| hosted `n/a{class}` sweep | `hosted_metric_view_renders_na_class_for_native_only_metrics` |
| nested measured durations + scope coords | `trace_view_resolves_nested_measured_durations_and_scope_coords` |
| unbounded turn profile renders typed `n/a` | `turn_phase_profile_unbounded_renders_typed_na` |
| phase partition covers the wall | `turn_phase_profile_partitions_the_wall` |
| unlisted sink → egress refusal, never a delivered row | `unlisted_sink_is_an_egress_refusal_never_a_delivered_row` |
| subscriber tails `read`, delivers via egress, appends delivered | `subscriber_tails_read_delivers_through_egress_and_appends_delivered` |
| MCP propagated call rides `_meta` | `call_tool_propagated_rides_the_meta_slot` (hh-mcp unit) |
